description: Transcribe a public video/audio URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Google Drive). Waits up to ~25s so short videos come back in one call; if still processing, call get_transcript with the returned id (that call waits too) until status is "complete". Limits: public links only (no private/login-required videos, no live streams), up to 150 minutes.

url.description: Public video or audio URL to transcribe.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning (0-55, default 25).

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to POST the result to on completion.

name: transcribe_url
title: Transcribe a video or audio URL
